---
name: Change request
about: Propose a capability, contract, documentation, or tooling improvement
title: ''
---

## Need and outcome

Describe the problem, affected users or consumers, and the observable result
that would resolve it.

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest useful change and relevant constraints. Identify whether
it affects extraction, selection, formulas, API/CLI, profiles, schemas, tooling,
or documentation. Separate package responsibilities from consumer behavior.

## Contract and output impact

Can reported metrics or result shapes change? Which versioned identities would
need to change, and how should historical results remain reproducible? Use
"none" when this is a documentation or tooling change with no output impact.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Desired behavior and boundaries are defined.
- [ ] Appropriate validation and documentation are identified.
- [ ] Release and downstream adoption requirements are identified, if applicable.

## Evidence and dependencies

Link supporting evidence and related work. Mark assumptions, unavailable
validation, and decisions that still need an owner. Do not attach private NOFO
content, credentials, local paths, or source-bearing reports.
